about_the_game:
GNOMONIC - The Art RPG! In this ART-PG, walk through watercolor paintings, fight in real-time projectile battles, solve puzzles with shadows, meet friends with creative talents in worlds themed by artistic mediums, and discover a story about how we experience art...
and how art experiences us.

Shoot equipped projectiles down lanes to simultaneously attack and defend! Every enemy-type has unique attacks and their own battlefields, from projectiles that jump between lanes or burrow underground to battlefield orientations with more to manage.

Customize how you battle with Stuff that you can equip to three projectile slots, Specials that allow you to use one powerful ability, and Dials that provide passive effects! Find them dropped around the world or dropped by defeated enemies, allowing you to use enemy projectiles and abilities.

Cast your shadow over objects for special interactions and puzzle solving! And discover new abilities that will allow you to traverse new obstacles and solve more puzzles.

Throughout it all, a prophecy persists: “LIGHT will unite with SHADE and free the GNOMON.” But... 𝚆𝚑𝚊𝚝 𝚒𝚜 𝚊 𝙶𝙽𝙾𝙼𝙾𝙽?
